description: Validation of the noncentral chi2 power for the Section 6 experiment with two luminous sources: H1 truths with (q_M, q_f) = (1, 1) at 12 cells of the Asimov grid xiP2lum_q1_f1 chosen by roman_sec6_power.py --select-validation with the luminous H0 summary (lambda 6-45, isotropic geometries, F146 = 21 total, g = 0), 100 noise realizations each at the cell geometry and (xi_rel, P). Catalog: build_h1_bspl_catalog.py --sec6-validation. Runner with --truth-kind h1a, SAVE_ARRAYS=1 and fit_policy_test_a_luminous_v1.json, then lrt_omega_profile.py with the same policy, as gv_sec6_h0_lum_v1. Compare with roman_sec6_power.py --validate (k under H1).
